panel.title: Noct Effects
panel.subtitle: Umbriel effects
panel.mix_tip: Choose the effect for each slot: border, cursor, screen, window and animations.
panel.tint_tip: Tint only affects Mono. If Mono is not active, changing it enables Mono.
panel.intensity_tip: Intensity only affects Mono. If Mono is not active, moving it enables Mono.
panel.mono_inactive: Mono is not active · Screen = {screen}. Adjust tint or intensity to enable it.

neon.name: Neon
neon.tip: Pulsing border, cursor glow, vignette and bouncy animations.

cinema.name: Cinema
cinema.tip: Screen vignette, window scanlines and a short cursor trail.

matrix.name: Matrix
matrix.tip: Scanlines, pulsing border, long cursor path and workspace wipe.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.tip: Only a live border around the focused window.

custom.name: Free
custom.tip: Start with no effects and add only the ones you choose in Mix.

mono.name: Mono
mono.tip: The whole desktop in gray with scanlines and vignette; tint and intensity apply here.

off.name: Off
off.tip: Disable all effects. The saved mix is kept.

mix.title: Mix effects
mix.hint: Tap the value to cycle: Auto → Off → installed effects.
mix.clear_tip: Remove all overrides and return to each preset’s configuration.
mix.value_tip_auto: Uses the preset effect. Tap to change.
mix.value_tip_off: Disables this slot. Tap to change.
mix.auto_off_hint: Auto uses the preset; Off disables the slot.

screen.label: Screen
screen.tip: Effect applied to the whole output.

windows_move.label: Window anim.
windows_move.tip: Animation when moving or resizing windows.

cursor.glow: Soft halo that breathes around the pointer.
cursor.trail: Short trail that follows the pointer and fades in ~300 ms.
cursor.trail-path: Long ~2 s path along the pointer’s movement.

screen.noct-mono: Gray with scanlines and vignette. Tint and intensity apply here.

window.scanlines: Subtle horizontal lines over each window.

windows_in.reveal: The window enters from one side.

windows_out.reveal: The window leaves to one side.

windows_move.squash: Soft bounce when moving or resizing windows.
